summary: Fixed the ledger package to follow docs/conventions.md: half-away-from-zero rounding via ledger.core everywhere, single leading minus in amount formatting (incl. HTML total cells), header-over-dialect layout precedence, jurisdiction always written by the statement writer, fiscal quarter boundary, rate lookup (earlier months only), rate-file month ranges, reversals booked/valued/taxed as their original, per-entry rounded totals (monthly, journal cells, revaluation), tax rules effective on their start date, returns by valuation quarter, and median rounding in recurring payments. All 755 unit tests and tools/audit.py (0 failed checks) pass.
